description: Place the order with checkout.payment (instruments[].handler_id from the business profile, e.g. bank_transfer). Only call after the buyer approved the total. meta.idempotency-key is required. The result carries order.id and a one-time order.order_token for get_order. Card, if listed in the profile (any currency): handler_id card_payment_page answers status requires_escalation with continue_url = Stripe-hosted payment page (de.glasstopfen.payment_page); hand the link to the buyer, nothing is placed until Stripe confirms, then get_checkout shows status completed with the order. handler_id stripe_payments takes instruments[].credential = {type: stripe_payment_token, token: spt_...}. Bank transfer (EUR orders only; other currencies get bank_transfer_eur_only and nothing is placed): the order is on hold and the result contains de.glasstopfen.payment_instructions (account_holder, iban, bic, bank_name, amount, currency, reference = order number, payment_due, payment_deadline = transfer deadline, currently 7 days, after it the order is cancelled automatically); show these exact values to the buyer. The destination is fixed by create/update_checkout (countries without delivery: country_not_supported); complete_checkout never changes it: the same destination may be resent, a different one answers destination_change_not_allowed and nothing is placed. Placing the order concludes a binding contract (terms: /legal/agb, withdrawal: /legal/widerruf).
name: complete_checkout
title: Complete checkout
